My lower secondary education gave me a solid foundation, but I prefer applying it through physics and art—like calculating light angles in photography. I enjoy problem-solving but avoid memorizing formulas.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, especially when tackling unfamiliar concepts. My neuroticism score of 59 makes me prone to stress, but I manage it by breaking problems into smaller steps and using practical examples. For instance, I calm down by relating math to hiking trails or football stats.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I used AI tools like Wolfram Alpha for quick checks on calculus problems. It helped me verify my work but sometimes gave confusing outputs. I learned to cross-check with simpler methods, which made it a useful supplement without overwhelming me.
